Weekday Lunch Diaries
steamed rice | dal bhorta | curry leaf thogayal 

this is my way of exploring india one bite at a time :) 

do you want the dal bhorta and curry leaf thogayal recipe? let me know in the comments :) 

Dal Bhorta: 
its a comforting and soulful dish that holds a special place in Indian cuisine. 
hailing from the heart of Bengali culinary traditions, it’s a humble yet incredibly flavorful dish made primarily from lentils, typically red or yellow lentils (masoor dal or moong dal). just another fun way of eating dal i feel :) 

Curry Leaf Thogayal: 
this vibrant and aromatic South Indian condiment celebrates the distinctive flavors of curry leaves. Thogayal, also known as thuvaiyal, is a versatile chutney-like preparation that’s a staple in Tamil Nadu cuisine, and curry leaf thogayal is a standout variation, cherished for its unique taste and health benefits.
